description: The line plot illustrates the BLEU scores of four different models—Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi—across a range of input values on the x-axis, which spans from 0.0 to 10.0 with labeled tick marks at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," ranges from 18 to 28, with horizontal grid lines at intervals of 2. Each model is represented by a distinct line with a unique color and marker style: Consistency-CE is shown with a light purple dashed line and circular markers; Inconsistency-CE with a dark purple dashed line and square markers; Inconsistency-CE-MP with a blue dashed line and square markers; and Consistency-Bi with a red solid line and star markers. The Consistency-Bi model consistently achieves the highest BLEU scores, starting at approximately 22.5 at x = 0.0 and increasing to about 28.5 at x = 10.0. The Inconsistency-CE-MP model starts at a BLEU score of approximately 19.0 and rises to about 27.0. The Inconsistency-CE model begins at a BLEU score of approximately 20.5 and increases to about 27.5. The Consistency-CE model starts at a BLEU score of approximately 19.5 and increases to about 27.0. All models show an increasing trend in BLEU score as the x-axis value increases.
